basis.governing_question: How should Seguros Atlântida redesign the operating model of its five business units and plan the transition to it?

sub_questions.question: How do the five business units organize their work, processes and costs today?
Where do cost, workload and performance gaps in the five units matter most for the new model?
Which target operating model for the five units can the executive committee approve?
How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?

drivers.evidence: all five business units (claims, underwriting, sales, customer service and finance)

work.unit: Unit diagnosed (interviews, process walk-throughs, workload and cost baseline)

phase_work.why: Five units diagnosed two at a time in three rounds; above the typical 4 to 8 weeks because all five units are covered.

work.unit: Target model for the whole organization (structure, roles, governance)
Unit-level design detailed with the unit's leaders
Transition plan for one business unit, sequenced with the others

phase_work.why: Whole-model design, then unit designs and unit transition plans, each two at a time, and one sign-off cycle; above typical 6 to 10 weeks.

sizing.levers: Run three units at once instead of two, or diagnose three representative units and extend to the other two from data.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the current organization, process and cost baseline of the five business units and prioritize the areas to redesign.

gate.label: Go/no-go on design
gate.decision: Go or no-go on designing the target model for the areas prioritized in the diagnostic?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target operating model for the five business units and a transition plan for each unit.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final target model and transition plan by unit for the executive committee?

architect_notes: Engagement length is estimated at 25 to 29 weeks; slower unit rounds, target-model design and unit transition plans would push it toward 32.
Public research lists Lisbon, Porto and 12 regional offices; confirm whether offices are in the Diagnostic, which would add a site driver and weeks.
No Implementation phase: the engagement type is assessment, so the transition is planned inside Design, not executed.
No Handover phase: the executive committee receives the result at the Design gate; add one if each unit head must receive a plan separately.
